reason: The batch report from a named independent lab is exactly what I look for, and I can check it before I pay. One box at $24.99 is a low-risk try, and a sachet I take in the evening is easier for me to remember than a bottle on the counter.
objection: It is a brand with no reviews yet and it is made in China, so I would open the lab report and match the batch number before I trusted any of it. Two capsules a day is also a bit annoying.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report on the page were missing, did not match the batch number, or the lab turned out not to be a real, independent one, I would not buy.
